content:
Qachon ishlatiladi:
Bu struktura biror ish-harakatning haqiqiy sababini, odatda kutilganidan farqli holda, ta'kidlab ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi. Suhbatda o'zingiz haqingizda chuqurroq va ishonarli fikr bildirmoqchi bo'lsangiz juda foydali — chunki avval "noto'g'ri" sababni rad etib, keyin "to'g'ri" sababni taqdim etasiz.

Misollar:
1. I go to the gym not because I enjoy it, but because I want to stay in shape.
(Men sportzalga yoqtirganim uchun emas, balki formada bo'lish uchun boraman.)

2. She moved to another city not because she disliked her hometown, but because she found a better job opportunity.
(U shahrini o'zgartirdi, tug'ilgan shahrini yoqtirmagani uchun emas, balki yaxshiroq ish topgani uchun.)

Speaking Part 1:
Do you like studying English?
Honestly, I study English not because it's compulsory at school, but because I want to travel and communicate with people around the world.

Qachon ishlatiladi:
Bu ibora o'tmishdagi aniq bir voqeadan hozirgi paytgacha davom etib kelayotgan holatni bildirish uchun ishlatiladi. Odatda o'sha voqea avval eslatib o'tiladi, so'ng "since then" yordamida o'shandan beri nima o'zgargani aytiladi.

Misollar:
1. I broke my leg last winter. Since then, I've been more careful while skiing.
(O'tgan qishda oyog'im sindi. O'shandan buyon chang'i uchishda ehtiyotkorroq bo'lyapman.)

2. We met at a conference five years ago, and we've stayed close friends since then.
(Biz besh yil oldin konferensiyada tanishgan edik va o'shandan buyon yaqin do'st bo'lib qoldik.)

Speaking Part 2:
Describe a moment that changed your life.
When I first moved to a big city for university, I felt completely lost. Since then, I've learned to be independent and manage my own time.

meaning: Na faqat bunaqa, balki bunaqa ham
content:
Qachon ishlatiladi:
Bu struktura ikkita fikrni bir vaqtda ta'kidlash uchun, ya'ni birinchisi kutilgan bo'lsa, ikkinchisi qo'shimcha ravishda ham to'g'ri ekanini ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi. Nutqni boyitish va fikrni kuchaytirish uchun juda foydali.

Misollar:
1. This course is not only useful for beginners but also challenging enough for advanced learners.
(Bu kurs nafaqat yangi boshlovchilar uchun foydali, balki ilg'or o'quvchilar uchun ham yetarlicha murakkab.)

2. She is not only a talented singer but also a skilled songwriter.
(U nafaqat iqtidorli qo'shiqchi, balki mohir qo'shiq muallifi ham.)

Speaking Part 1:
What do you like about your job?
I enjoy it because it's not only well-paid but also gives me the chance to meet interesting people every day.

Qachon ishlatiladi:
Bu ibora biror vaziyatda boshqa hech qanday tanlov qolmagani, faqat bitta yo'l qolganini ta'kidlash uchun ishlatiladi. Ko'pincha majburiy yoki noxush qarorlarni tasvirlashda qo'llaniladi.

Misollar:
1. The flight was cancelled, so we had no choice but to wait at the airport overnight.
(Parvoz bekor qilindi, shuning uchun bizda aeroportda tunni o'tkazishdan boshqa iloj qolmadi.)

2. When my laptop broke down before the deadline, I had no choice but to finish the report on my phone.
(Muddat tugashidan oldin noutbukim sinib qolganda, hisobotni telefonimda tugatishdan boshqa ilojim qolmadi.)

Speaking Part 2:
Describe a difficult decision you had to make.
When the prices suddenly went up, I had no choice but to cut down on unnecessary expenses.

Qachon ishlatiladi:
Bu ibora hikoya yoki voqeani aytib berishda, keyingi hodisaga o'tishda tabiiy bog'lovchi sifatida ishlatiladi. Speaking qismida voqealarni izchil va qiziqarli tarzda bog'lash uchun juda foydali.

Misollar:
1. I was walking home late at night when I heard a strange noise. Then what happened was, a cat jumped out of the bushes.
(Kechasi kech uyga qaytayotgandim, g'alati ovoz eshitdim. Keyin nima bo'ldi desangiz, buta orasidan mushuk sakrab chiqdi.)

2. We were stuck in traffic for an hour. Then what happened was, the driver found a shortcut through a side street.
(Bir soat tirbandlikda qolib ketdik. Keyin nima bo'ldi desangiz, haydovchi yon ko'chadan qisqa yo'l topdi.)

Speaking Part 2:
Describe an unforgettable event.
Everyone was waiting nervously for the results. Then what happened was, my name was announced first, and the whole room started cheering.

Qachon ishlatiladi:
Bu struktura bir nechta narsa yoki sabab haqida gapirib, ulardan bittasini alohida ta'kidlab ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi. Rasmiyroq va akademik uslubdagi nutqqa mos keladi.

Misollar:
1. There are several reasons for the delay, one of which is the shortage of raw materials.
(Kechikishning bir nechta sababi bor, ularning biri xom-ashyo yetishmasligi.)

2. The city has many beautiful parks, one of which is right next to my house.
(Shaharda ko'plab chiroyli bog'lar bor, ularning biri aynan uyim yonida joylashgan.)

Speaking Part 3:
Why do you think people prefer living in cities?
There are many advantages to city life, one of which is easy access to job opportunities and public services.

Qachon ishlatiladi:
"The way" biror ish qanday tarzda, qanday uslubda bajarilishini tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladi. Undan keyin ko'pincha ega + fe'l keladi va bu struktura fikrni tabiiy va ravon qilib beradi.

Misollar:
1. I really admire the way she stays calm under pressure.
(Uning bosim ostida ham xotirjam qolish uslubiga men chindan ham qoyil qolaman.)

2. The way he explains difficult topics makes learning much easier.
(Uning qiyin mavzularni tushuntirish usuli o'rganishni ancha osonlashtiradi.)

Speaking Part 1:
Who do you admire the most?
I admire my grandmother the most, especially the way she always stays positive no matter what happens.

Qachon ishlatiladi:
Bu ibora biror ish juda kam yoki deyarli sodir bo'lmasligini bildirish uchun ishlatiladi. Odatiy fe'ldan oldin qo'yiladi va "almost never" ma'nosini beradi.

Misollar:
1. I hardly ever eat fast food because I prefer home-cooked meals.
(Men deyarli hech qachon fast food yemayman, chunki uyda pishirilgan taomlarni afzal ko'raman.)

2. She hardly ever complains, even when things go wrong.
(Ishlar yaxshi ketmaganda ham u deyarli hech qachon shikoyat qilmaydi.)

Speaking Part 1:
Do you often watch TV?
Not really, I hardly ever watch TV these days because I spend most of my free time reading or exercising.

Qachon ishlatiladi:
Bu struktura hozirgi vaziyatdan afsuslanish yoki real bo'lmagan istakni bildirish uchun ishlatiladi. "I wish I could" imkoniyat yo'qligiga, "I wish I was" esa boshqacha holatda bo'lishni istashga ishora qiladi.

Misollar:
1. I wish I could speak French fluently; it would help me a lot at work.
(Qaniydi frantsuz tilida ravon gapira olsam edi, bu ishimda juda foydali bo'lardi.)

2. I wish I was on holiday right now instead of sitting in this office.
(Qaniydi hozir bu ofisda o'tirish o'rniga ta'tilda bo'lsam edim.)

Speaking Part 1:
Is there a skill you'd like to have?
Definitely, I wish I could play the piano, but I've never had the time to learn it properly.

Qachon ishlatiladi:
Bu ibora ikki narsani miqdor yoki daraja jihatidan taqqoslashda, ular teng yoki bir xil ekanini ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi. Ba'zan "garchi... bo'lsa ham" ma'nosida ham qo'llaniladi.

Misollar:
1. I enjoy reading novels as much as watching movies.
(Men romanlar o'qishni filmlar tomosha qilish kabi bir xil yoqtiraman.)

2. As much as I love my job, I still need a proper holiday sometimes.
(Ishimni qanchalik yaxshi ko'rmasin, baribir ba'zida haqiqiy dam olish kerak.)

Speaking Part 1:
Do you prefer spending time indoors or outdoors?
I enjoy spending time outdoors as much as relaxing at home, it really depends on my mood.

Qachon ishlatiladi:
Bu struktura ikki xil natija yoki holat mumkin bo'lganda, biror qaror yoki fikr shu holatdan qat'iy nazar to'g'ri qolishini ta'kidlash uchun ishlatiladi.

Misollar:
1. I'm going to the party whether it rains or not.
(Yomg'ir yog'sa ham, yog'masa ham, men ziyofatga boraman.)

2. She hasn't decided whether to accept the job offer or not.
(U ish taklifini qabul qilish yoki qilmaslikka hali qaror qilmadi.)

Speaking Part 3:
Do you think people should always follow their plans?
Not necessarily, but I do think that whether we succeed or not, it's important to keep trying.

Qachon ishlatiladi:
"Unlike" ikki narsa yoki shaxs orasidagi farqni ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi. Gap boshida yoki o'rtasida kelib, taqqoslanayotgan ikkinchi tomonni ta'kidlaydi.

Misollar:
1. Unlike my brother, I'm not a big fan of spicy food.
(Akamdan farqli o'laroq, men achchiq taomlarning katta muxlisi emasman.)

2. Unlike traditional classrooms, online courses allow students to learn at their own pace.
(An'anaviy sinflardan farqli o'laroq, onlayn kurslar talabalarga o'z tezligida o'rganish imkonini beradi.)

Speaking Part 3:
How has education changed over the years?
Unlike in the past, students today have access to endless information through the internet.

Qachon ishlatiladi:
Bu qisqartirilgan struktura "when it is needed" yoki "when it is done" kabi to'liq gaplarni qisqartirib, nutqni ravonroq qilish uchun ishlatiladi. Odatda rasmiyroq yoki ixcham uslubda qo'llaniladi.

Misollar:
1. The manual explains how to reset the device when needed.
(Qo'llanma zarur bo'lganda qurilmani qanday qayta tiklashni tushuntiradi.)

2. When asked about the delay, the company apologized to its customers.
(Kechikish haqida so'ralganda, kompaniya mijozlaridan uzr so'radi.)

Speaking Part 3:
Should people always ask for help?
I think it's completely normal to ask for support when needed, rather than trying to handle everything alone.

header: Either one / Neither one / None of them
meaning: Ikkalasidan bittasi / Ikkalasi ham emas / Hech biri
content:
Qachon ishlatiladi:
"Either one" ikkitadan birini, "neither one" ikkalasi ham emasligini, "none of them" esa uchtadan ortiq narsalarning hech birini bildirish uchun ishlatiladi.

Misollar:
1. You can choose either one of these two restaurants; they're both great.
(Bu ikki restorandan xohlagan birini tanlashingiz mumkin, ikkalasi ham ajoyib.)

2. I tried both jackets, but neither one fit me well.
(Ikkala kurtkani ham kiyib ko'rdim, lekin ikkalasi ham menga yarashmadi.)

Speaking Part 1:
Do you prefer tea or coffee?
Honestly, none of them really; I usually just drink water in the morning.

Qachon ishlatiladi:
Bu struktura kimdandir kutilayotgan yoki rejalashtirilgan ish-harakatni bildirish uchun ishlatiladi, ko'pincha bu ish hali bajarilmagan yoki reja bo'yicha bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan holatlarda qo'llaniladi.

Misollar:
1. I'm supposed to meet my colleague at 9 a.m., but I might be a few minutes late.
(Men hamkasbim bilan ertalab soat 9 da uchrashishim kerak, lekin bir necha daqiqa kechikishim mumkin.)

2. This medicine is supposed to be taken twice a day after meals.
(Bu dori kunda ikki marta ovqatdan keyin ichilishi kerak.)

Speaking Part 1:
What time do you usually get up?
I'm supposed to wake up at 6, but honestly, I often end up getting up a bit later.

header: It's not that... it's just that...
meaning: U uchun emas, aslida bu uchun
content:
Qachon ishlatiladi:
Bu struktura noto'g'ri tushunilishi mumkin bo'lgan fikrni aniqlashtirish, haqiqiy sababni yumshoq tarzda tushuntirish uchun ishlatiladi. Suhbatda diplomatik va tushuntiruvchi ohangni beradi.

Misollar:
1. It's not that I don't like the plan, it's just that I need more time to think about it.
(Rejani yoqtirmayotganim uchun emas, aslida menga o'ylab ko'rish uchun ko'proq vaqt kerakligi uchun.)

2. It's not that she's lazy, it's just that she's been extremely busy lately.
(U dangasa bo'lgani uchun emas, aslida so'nggi paytda juda band bo'lgani uchun.)

Speaking Part 1:
Do you enjoy cooking?
It's not that I dislike cooking, it's just that I rarely have enough free time for it.

Qachon ishlatiladi:
Bu struktura sifat (adjective) bilan gap boshlanib, undan keyin ega va fe'l kelishi orqali his-tuyg'u sababini ta'kidlash uchun ishlatiladi. Nutqni ekspressiv va tabiiy qiladi.

Misollar:
1. Surprised by the sudden change of plan, we quickly rearranged our schedule.
(Rejaning kutilmagan o'zgarishidan hayratda qolib, biz jadvalimizni tezda o'zgartirdik.)

2. Worried about the exam results, she couldn't concentrate on anything else.
(Imtihon natijalari haqida xavotirlanib, u boshqa hech narsaga diqqatini qarata olmadi.)

Speaking Part 2:
Describe a time you felt nervous.
Worried about my presentation, I practised my speech in front of the mirror all night.

Qachon ishlatiladi:
Bu struktura o'tmishda qilinmagan biror ish uchun afsuslanishni bildirish uchun ishlatiladi. "Regret" dan keyin "not + V-ing" kelishi, o'sha ishni qilmaganidan pushaymon ekanini anglatadi.

Misollar:
1. I regret not studying harder for the entrance exam.
(Kirish imtihoniga ko'proq tayyorlanmaganimdan afsuslanaman.)

2. He regrets not spending more time with his family when he was younger.
(U yoshligida oilasi bilan ko'proq vaqt o'tkazmaganidan afsuslanadi.)

Speaking Part 2:
Describe something you would do differently if you could.
Honestly, I regret not learning a second language earlier, it would have opened so many doors for me.

header: Spend time doing / Have difficulty Ving / Feel comfortable doing / There is someone doing
content:
Qachon ishlatiladi:
Bu strukturalar kundalik suhbatda juda tez-tez uchraydi: "spend time doing" — vaqtni biror ishga sarflash, "have difficulty doing" — biror ishni bajarishda qiyinchilikka duch kelish, "feel comfortable doing" — biror ishni bajarishda o'zini erkin his qilish, "there is someone doing" — kimdir biror ishni bajarayotganini tasvirlash uchun.

Misollar:
1. I spend a lot of time reading before I go to sleep.
(Uxlashdan oldin o'qishga ko'p vaqt sarflayman.)

2. At first, I had difficulty understanding native speakers, but I feel much more comfortable communicating now.
(Boshida ona tilida so'zlashuvchilarni tushunishda qiynalgan edim, ammo hozir muloqot qilishda o'zimni ancha erkin his qilaman.)

Speaking Part 1:
How do you usually spend your weekends?
There is usually someone cooking in my family on weekends, and I spend most of my time helping in the kitchen.

Qachon ishlatiladi:
Bu struktura biror ish qanday uslubda yoki qanday tarzda amalga oshirilganini tasvirlash, o'sha usulning sifatini ta'kidlash uchun ishlatiladi.

Misollar:
1. He solved the problem in a way that is both simple and effective.
(U muammoni ham oddiy, ham samarali usulda hal qildi.)

2. She always speaks in a way that is respectful, even during disagreements.
(U hatto kelishmovchilik paytida ham har doim hurmatli usulda gapiradi.)

Speaking Part 3:
What makes a good leader?
A good leader communicates with their team in a way that is clear and motivating.

Qachon ishlatiladi:
Bu ibora biror holat yoki his-tuyg'uning darajasi shu qadar kuchli bo'lganini, natijada aniq bir oqibatga olib kelganini ta'kidlash uchun ishlatiladi.

Misollar:
1. I was so tired, so much so that I fell asleep on the bus.
(Men shunchalik charchagan edimki, hattoki avtobusda uxlab qolibman.)

2. The movie was so boring, so much so that half the audience left before it ended.
(Film shunchalik zerikarli ediki, hattoki tomoshabinlarning yarmi tugashidan oldin ketib qolishdi.)

Speaking Part 2:
Describe a moment you were extremely excited.
I was so nervous before my exam, so much so that I couldn't eat breakfast that morning.

header: Not as often as before / Not as often as I should
content:
Qachon ishlatiladi:
Bu struktura biror ishning avvalgi holatga yoki kerakli darajaga nisbatan kamroq sodir bo'layotganini bildirish uchun ishlatiladi.

Misollar:
1. I visit my grandparents, but not as often as before.
(Buvi-bobomga tashrif buyuraman, lekin avvalgidek tez-tez emas.)

2. I exercise, but honestly, not as often as I should.
(Sport bilan shug'ullanaman, lekin rostini aytsam, kerakligicha emas.)

Speaking Part 1:
Do you read books often?
I love reading, but I read not as often as I should because of my busy schedule.

Qachon ishlatiladi:
Gap oxirida qo'yiladigan "though" gapdagi asosiy fikrga qarama-qarshi bo'lgan qo'shimcha ma'lumotni yumshoq tarzda kiritish uchun ishlatiladi, og'zaki nutqda juda keng tarqalgan.

Misollar:
1. The weather was terrible. We still enjoyed the trip, though.
(Ob-havo dahshatli edi. Baribir sayohatdan zavqlanib qoldik.)

2. It's quite expensive. It's worth the money, though.
(Bu ancha qimmat. Baribir pulga arziydi.)

Speaking Part 1:
Do you enjoy your current job?
It can be stressful sometimes. I really enjoy it overall, though.

Qachon ishlatiladi:
"Unless" biror shart bajarilmasa, natija sodir bo'lmasligini yoki boshqacha bo'lishini bildirish uchun ishlatiladi, "if not" ma'nosini beradi.

Misollar:
1. I won't be able to attend the meeting unless I finish this report first.
(Agar avval bu hisobotni tugatmasam, yig'ilishga qatnasha olmayman.)

2. Unless it rains, we're planning to have a picnic on Saturday.
(Agar yomg'ir yog'masa, biz shanba kuni piknikka borishni rejalashtiryapmiz.)

Speaking Part 3:
What could help reduce traffic in big cities?
Traffic won't improve unless the government invests more in public transportation.

Qachon ishlatiladi:
Bu struktura rasmiy reja, ko'rsatma yoki majburiyatni bildirish uchun ishlatiladi, ko'pincha yozma yoki rasmiy nutqda "be + to + infinitive" ko'rinishida uchraydi.

Misollar:
1. The president is to visit the region next week.
(Prezident kelasi hafta mintaqaga tashrif buyurishi kerak.)

2. If we are to succeed, we need to work together as a team.
(Agar biz muvaffaqiyatga erishmoqchi bo'lsak, jamoa bo'lib ishlashimiz kerak.)

Speaking Part 3:
What should companies do to keep employees motivated?
If a company is to keep its employees motivated, it needs to offer fair rewards and recognition.

Qachon ishlatiladi:
"So that" biror ish-harakatning maqsadini bildirish uchun ishlatiladi, ya'ni bir narsa nima uchun qilinayotganini tushuntiradi.

Misollar:
1. I woke up early so that I could catch the first train.
(Birinchi poyezdga ulgurish uchun erta uyg'ondim.)

2. She saves money every month so that she can travel abroad next year.
(U kelasi yili chet elga sayohat qilishi uchun har oy pul jamg'aradi.)

Speaking Part 1:
Why do you learn English?
I learn English so that I can study abroad and have more career opportunities.

Qachon ishlatiladi:
Bu yerda "that" ravish sifatida ishlatilib, sifat yoki ravishning darajasini kuchaytirish yoki cheklash uchun qo'llaniladi, ko'pincha inkor gaplarda "unchalik" ma'nosida keladi.

Misollar:
1. The movie wasn't that interesting, to be honest.
(Rostini aytsam, film unchalik qiziqarli emas edi.)

2. I didn't expect the exam to be that difficult.
(Imtihon shunchalik qiyin bo'lishini kutmagandim.)

Speaking Part 1:
Was your last trip enjoyable?
It was okay, but it wasn't that exciting because the weather was quite bad the whole time.

Qachon ishlatiladi:
Bu ibora biror fikrni to'liq emas, balki qisman tasdiqlash yoki yumshatish uchun ishlatiladi, ko'pincha murakkab yoki ikkilanishli fikrlarni bildirishda foydalidir.

Misollar:
1. In a way, moving to a new city was the best decision I ever made.
(Bir tomondan, yangi shaharga ko'chib o'tish men qilgan eng yaxshi qaror edi.)

2. In a way, I understand why she made that choice, even though I disagree with it.
(Qisman, uning nega shunday tanlov qilganini tushunaman, garchi bunga qo'shilmasam ham.)

Speaking Part 3:
Is it good for young people to work while studying?
In a way, yes, because it teaches them responsibility, but it can also affect their studies.

Qachon ishlatiladi:
"Somewhat" biror sifat yoki holatning darajasini yumshatish, "to some extent" ma'nosida ishlatish uchun qo'llaniladi. Rasmiyroq nutqda "a bit" o'rniga ishlatiladi.

Misollar:
1. The results were somewhat disappointing compared to what we expected.
(Natijalar biz kutganimizga nisbatan biroz umidsizlantiruvchi edi.)

2. I'm somewhat familiar with the topic, but I'd like to learn more.
(Men mavzu bilan ozgina tanishman, lekin ko'proq o'rganishni xohlayman.)

Speaking Part 3:
How has technology changed communication?
Technology has somewhat improved communication, but it has also made face-to-face interaction less common.

Qachon ishlatiladi:
Bu struktura "who is/are" kabi qismlarni tushirib, fe'lni "-ing" shakliga o'tkazish orqali gapni qisqartirish uchun ishlatiladi. Nutqni ravonroq va tabiiyroq qiladi, ayniqsa yozma va rasmiy nutqda foydali.

Misollar:
1. The man standing near the door is my new colleague.
(Eshik yonida turgan erkak mening yangi hamkasbim.)

2. Students studying abroad often face difficulties adapting to a new culture.
(Chet elda o'qiyotgan talabalar ko'pincha yangi madaniyatga moslashishda qiyinchilikka duch kelishadi.)

Speaking Part 3:
What challenges do international students face?
Students living far from home often struggle with homesickness and cultural differences.

Qachon ishlatiladi:
Bu ibora avvalgi gapda aytilgan sababdan kelib chiqadigan natijani bog'lash uchun ishlatiladi, "that's why" ga o'xshash ammo ko'proq bog'langan gap ichida qo'llaniladi.

Misollar:
1. The traffic was terrible this morning, which is why I was late for work.
(Bugun ertalab tirbandlik dahshatli edi, mana shu sababli ishga kechikdim.)

2. She has always loved animals, which is why she decided to become a vet.
(U doim hayvonlarni yaxshi ko'rgan, shuning uchun veterinar bo'lishga qaror qilgan.)

Speaking Part 3:
Why do many young people move to big cities?
Cities usually offer better job opportunities, which is why so many young people choose to move there.

Qachon ishlatiladi:
Bu bog'lovchilar bir voqea sodir bo'lgach, darhol keyingi voqea yuz berishini bildirish uchun ishlatiladi.

Misollar:
1. As soon as I got home, I took a hot shower and went straight to bed.
(Uyga kelishim bilanoq, issiq dush qabul qilib, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yotib qoldim.)

2. Once you finish the project, please send it to the whole team.
(Loyihani tugatishingiz bilanoq, uni butun jamoaga yuboring.)

Speaking Part 2:
Describe a time you had to act quickly.
As soon as I heard the alarm, I grabbed my bag and rushed out of the building.

Qachon ishlatiladi:
"As" va "since" ma'lum bo'lgan yoki ravshan sababni bildirish uchun ishlatiladi, ko'pincha gap boshida keladi va "because" dan ko'ra yumshoqroq eshitiladi.

Misollar:
1. As it was raining heavily, we decided to stay home.
(Kuchli yomg'ir yog'ayotgani sababli, biz uyda qolishga qaror qildik.)

2. Since you're already here, why don't you join us for dinner?
(Sen allaqachon shu yerda ekansan, biz bilan kechki ovqatga qo'shilsang bo'lmaydimi?)

Speaking Part 1:
Why do you prefer living in the countryside?
As I grew up in a village, I feel much more relaxed surrounded by nature.

Qachon ishlatiladi:
Bu struktura bir ish tugatilgandan keyin sodir bo'lgan keyingi ish-harakatni bildirish uchun ishlatiladi, ikkita voqea orasidagi ketma-ketlikni ixcham tarzda ko'rsatadi.

Misollar:

Qachon ishlatiladi:
Bu dars ingliz tilida ko'p uchraydigan grammatik xatolarni eslab qolish va ulardan qochish uchun mo'ljallangan. Speaking va Writing qismlarida ballni pasaytirmaslik uchun bu xatolarni bilish juda muhim.

Keng tarqalgan xatolar va to'g'ri variantlari:
1. Noto'g'ri: "I have 25 years old." To'g'ri: "I am 25 years old."
2. Noto'g'ri: "She is agree with you." To'g'ri: "She agrees with you."
3. Noto'g'ri: "I am boring today." To'g'ri: "I am bored today."
4. Noto'g'ri: "He explained me the rule." To'g'ri: "He explained the rule to me."
5. Noto'g'ri: "I look forward to see you." To'g'ri: "I look forward to seeing you."

Speaking Part 3:
Why do you think students make grammar mistakes when speaking?
I think it happens because they translate directly from their native language, which is why practising common structures regularly really helps.
